The '''Mouthpiece''' is a [[villager]] profession that trades [[sacred texts]] for [[Crystal Heart|crystal hearts]] and [[Ofuda]]. It replaces the {{MCW|Librarian|librarian}}, and its job site block is the Lectern. It sells no enchanted books, since [[enchanting]] in Matcha Flavoured works through [[Blessing|blessings]] and Ofuda instead.

== Trades ==
{{Data/Trades/Mouthpiece}}
All trades can be used 999 times before restocking.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/librarian/1/paradise_lost.json}}</ref> Every level offers all of its trades.

=== Crystal hearts ===
At Novice level the mouthpiece exchanges [[Paradise Lost]] or [[The Divine Comedy]] for a crystal heart, one book per heart. It also sells 16 [[Stable Void]]s for 1 obol.

=== Ofuda ===
The Apprentice, Journeyman and Expert trades turn a sacred text and one or two crystal hearts into an Ofuda, an enchanted book that carries a named prayer:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/librarian/2/tanakh.json}}</ref>
{{Data/Ofuda}}
The Ofuda is applied to equipment with an [[anvil]], like a vanilla enchanted book; see [[Ofuda]].

=== Divine Fragment ===
At Master level the mouthpiece turns 2 crystal hearts and an echo shard into a [[Divine Fragment]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/librarian/5/crystal_heart.json}}</ref> The developer added this as a trade because divine fragments cannot be crafted directly.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.1-alpha|quote=Divine Fragments can be bought from the Mouthpiece with a Crystal Heart and Echo Shard (Can't be done by crafting since they're poison potatoes)}}</ref>

Like every villager, a mouthpiece that has been traded with will also buy its [[favorite food]] once, an upcoming trade that is not in [[Matcha Flavoured 1.12.2|1.12.2-beta]].

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|0.6-alpha|No longer sells Divine Fragments, to discourage mob farms.}}
{{History line|1.10|Added the Ofuda trades for [[The Tanakh]] (Prayer of Exodus) and [[The Quran]] (Prayer of The Prophet).}}
{{History line|1.12|Crystal hearts from trades can no longer be eaten.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Sells Divine Fragments for crystal hearts and an echo shard.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|The Ofuda trades require crystal hearts. The Divine Fragment trade costs 2 crystal hearts instead of 1.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/librarian/5/crystal_heart.json}}</ref>}}
}}

== Trivia ==
* Internally the profession is still <code>minecraft:librarian</code>; only its displayed name changes.<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/lang/en_us.json}}</ref>
* The developer has said the idea behind the Mouthpiece is that all of the world's religions point, in some way, to the pack's dead god.<ref>{{Cite video|id=wavOi0ULYpQ|title=How Criticism changed Matcha Flavoured|quote=I like the idea that all of these religions are pointing to something and in this world they were all pointing to the dead god in some way somehow.}}</ref>
